owner-only: Only the installation owner can do this.
too-many-attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.

sign-in.invalid-credentials: The user name or password is incorrect.

session.ended: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
session.refreshed-moments-ago: This session was refreshed a moment ago. Try again.

setup.already-completed: This installation is already set up. Sign in instead.

password.too-short_one: A password must be at least {{count, number}} character long.
password.too-short_other: A password must be at least {{count, number}} characters long.
password.too-long_one: A password can be at most {{count, number}} character long.
password.too-long_other: A password can be at most {{count, number}} characters long.

user-name.length_one: A user name must be {{minimum, number}} to {{count, number}} character long.
user-name.length_other: A user name must be {{minimum, number}} to {{count, number}} characters long.
user-name.characters: A user name can contain only letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores.

users.owner-cannot-be-disabled: The installation owner can't be disabled.
users.owner-cannot-be-deleted: The installation owner can't be deleted.

language.unreadable-body: Send the language as JSON: language en, uk, or null to follow the browser.
language.unsupported: “{{value}}” is not a language of the app. Use en, uk, or null to follow the browser.

token.unreadable-body: Send the token as JSON: a name, access ReadOnly or ReadAndDownload, and lifetime Days30, Days90, OneYear or Never.
token.name-required: Give the token a name, such as “Claude on the laptop”.
token.name-too-long_one: A token's name can be at most {{count, number}} character.
token.name-too-long_other: A token's name can be at most {{count, number}} characters.
token.access-required: Choose the token's access: Read only or Read and download.
token.read-only: This access token is read only. To send downloads, cancel following or mark Not interested from a script, create a token with “Read and download” access on your Profile page; see “Scripts and the API” in the README.
token.not-for-tokens: An access token can't do this. A token reads, and with “Read and download” access also sends downloads, cancels following and marks Not interested; everything else is done in the web app. See “Scripts and the API” in the README.
token.cancel-ends-replacement: This job also replaces a copy in the library, and an access token never touches a replacement. Cancel it on the Jobs page of the web app; see “Scripts and the API” in the README.
token.session-not-accepted: The MCP endpoint takes a personal access token, not a web app sign-in. Create a token on your Profile page and connect with it; see “Connect an AI assistant (MCP)” in the README.
token.too-many-requests_one: Too many requests with this access token: at most {{count, number}} a minute. Wait a minute and try again.
token.too-many-requests_other: Too many requests with this access token: at most {{count, number}} a minute. Wait a minute and try again.
